## Official example (05 §3)

### Comic Book (`comic-book`)

**Text-To-Image**

> Cinematic noir graphic-novel illustration, widescreen 16:9, a tense encounter inside a dim vintage watchmaker’s shop. View across a glass display counter from just behind an elderly male shopkeeper, whose balding head, gray hair, dark suit shoulder, and raised open hands dominate the right foreground. Across the counter, a stern young female detective stands on the left, framed from approximately mid-thigh upward. She leans slightly forward and looks directly at the shopkeeper with a composed, penetrating expression. She has pale skin, large sharply outlined eyes, arched dark eyebrows, dark lipstick, and short dark hair beneath a charcoal fedora with a black band. Her belted, double-breasted trench coat has broad turned-up lapels, shoulder epaulets, cuff straps, heavy folds, and a square metal belt buckle. One pale, visibly wrapped hand rests on the counter at the lower left; her other hand extends onto the glass near the center.

> The glass counter fills the bottom of the frame, displaying carefully arranged wristwatches, chains, and small metal objects in divided trays, with muted reflections of the hands and surrounding shop. Behind the detective, narrow dark wooden shelves and cabinets recede into the left background. On the right wall hangs a large aged circular clock face with dark hour marks. A small framed portrait, ornate clock mechanisms, pocket watches, and antique objects decorate the shelves. A bright exposed bulb inside a wire safety cage hangs near the upper center-right, casting warm light onto the scene; a distant table lamp glows at the far left.

> Restrained black, charcoal, ivory, and muted sepia palette, with warm amber highlights only around the lamps. Bold expressive ink contours, fine crosshatching, textured brush shading, detailed etched backgrounds, graphic facial shapes, strong chiaroscuro, and deep cinematic shadows. Elegant mature comic-book artwork with convincing depth and tactile old surfaces. No speech bubbles, captions, panel divisions, readable text, or watermark.

**Image-To-Video**

> [REFERENCE USE] Use the supplied comic-book image as the exact opening frame for a three-second continuous shot. [IDENTITY / CONTINUITY] Preserve the face, fedora, belted trench coat, wrapped hand, and stance of the detective. Keep the elderly shopkeeper in the right foreground with both open hands raised. Maintain the display trays, wall clock, hanging cage lamp, and shelf objects in their original positions. [SCENE] A dim antique watchmaker shop rendered as a restrained sepia-and-charcoal noir graphic novel. [ACTION 0-3s] The detective slowly lifts her gaze a fraction toward the face of the shopkeeper, holding her stern expression. Both hands remain resting on the glass. The shopkeeper stays still. [CAMERA] One very slow forward push toward the detective, retaining the shoulder and raised hands of the shopkeeper as foreground framing. No cuts. [LIGHT AND IMAGE] Preserve bold ink contours, fine hatching, textured shading, deep shadows, and the steady warm glow of the caged bulb. Keep reflections subtle and tied to the counter surface. [PRODUCTION SOUND] Quiet room tone and faint mechanical clock ticking only, with no dialogue or music. [NEGATIVES] No lip movement, gestures, new characters, shifting merchandise, lettering, speech balloons, saturation changes, photorealistic conversion, facial morphing, extra fingers, camera shake, or transitions.
